answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint identities backed by cryptographic attestation chains verifying unique hardware roots. Sybil swarms face exponential capital exhaustion through tiered staking: each duplicated identity requires exponential bond scaling. Zero-knowledge proofs verify these stakes without exposing private state. A malicious swarm attempting to counterfeit nodes in projects like juniper, sable, or marble faces superlinear costs, rendering mass node replication economically impossible.
